1856 exotheo {ex-o-theh'-o} or exotho {ex-o'-tho}

源自 1537 與 othero (推); 動詞

欽定本 - drive out 1, thrust in 1, 2

1) (強迫)推出去 (#徒 7:45|)
2) 趕向岸邊 (#徒 27:39|)
record.edic_text:
1856 exotheo {ex-o-theh'-o} or exotho {ex-o'-tho}

from 1537 and otheo (to push);; v


AV - drive out 1, thrust in 1, 2

1) to thrust out
2) expel from one's abode
3) to propel, drive

same.cexp: 趕出，趕走；擱淺，（船）攏上去
